deviations.what: Three wiring follow-ups outside any task's summary, done as t13b on a fresh worktree after t13 merged: (1) a --provider flag in the composition root so the decision provider (t10) is reachable end to end — no task covered wiring it; (2) deterministic delivery of the settle pose before the end frame in the stream's shutdown ordering — t13 found the settle pose was best-effort; (3) an automated stdio-mode end-to-end test — t13 verified stdio manually only.
deviations.reason: gaps found at integration: provider wiring uncovered by the plan; settle-pose ordering and stdio coverage discovered by t13

deviations.what: Conformance replay (t14) found that 'neurosymbolic-engine run --stdio' does not exit when its stdin closes: the tick loop stops and the stopped line is written, but the process lingers until SIGTERM. Fixed as t13c on a fresh worktree by the composition-root agent: EOF on the stdio reader cancels the run context so the process exits 0 after the end frame; covered by a Go test and the stdio e2e.
deviations.reason: a lifecycle bug found by the conformance stdio test; no task owns it
